title: Section 193 BNSS — Report of police officer

content.heading: Report of police officer on completion of investigation
content.text: Section 193 BNSS is the current provision for the police report on completion of investigation. Do not treat it as a word-for-word reprint of CrPC section 173. Read the official notified text. Pending investigations may still be governed by CrPC under BNSS section 531.
